edits.text: When the user asks to proceed with some of the requested modifications while others are still being decided, inform the user that performing the modifications now will change the order status to 'pending (items modified)' and prevent any further item modifications.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from failing to warn the user that partial modifications will change the order status and prevent subsequent modifications.

edits.text: When the user expresses an intent to modify a pending order, load the `retail:modify` skill before proposing any modification details to the user.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent has access to relevant modification rules before it begins proposing options to the user.

edits.text: When a user makes multiple requests that require tool calls, you must perform all necessary tool calls before providing a response that addresses all of the requests.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from providing a response for multiple requests before it has gathered all the necessary information from the database.

edits.text: When a user requests both a return and an exchange for a delivered order, you must call `exchange_delivered_order_items` before `return_delivered_order_items`.
edits.reason: Prevents the return action from changing the order status in a way that makes the subsequent exchange action impossible.

not_adopted.reason: a05 was chosen as a more systematic fix for the agent's rule-access issues during the proposal phase.
a12 is a more specific and critical fix for the state-dependent return/exchange sequence, and a12 implicitly handles the priority case for those specific actions.

output.summary: Added rules to ensure skills are loaded before proposals, all tool calls are completed before multi-request responses, specific sequences for return/exchange are followed, and users are warned about status changes from partial modifications.
